# Security policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| `main`  | ✅        |

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in this project, please **do not open a public issue**. Submit a private report via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/juan-miii/juan-miii.github.io/security/advisories/new) or email the contact listed in [`security.txt`](./apps/web/public/.well-known/security.txt).

Include as many details as possible:

- Description of the vulnerability and its impact.
- Steps to reproduce it.
- Project version and environment where it reproduces.
- Possible mitigation or patch, if you have one.

## What to expect

- You will receive an acknowledgment in a reasonable time.
- You will be kept informed of the investigation status.
- If the vulnerability is confirmed, a patch and, when appropriate, a security advisory will be published.

## Scope

This is a static site generated with Astro and published on GitHub Pages. It has no custom server, database or third-party integrations that handle user data beyond the public contact links.

## security.txt

The site exposes a [`security.txt`](./apps/web/public/.well-known/security.txt) with the contact and preferred language for security reports, following [RFC 9116](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9116).
